## F.1 Compatibility With CLEER Factor Releases {#f.1-compatibility-with-cleer-factor-releases}

Each version of this calculation is designed for a specific release of CLEER per-token accelerator energy factors.

| Calculation version | Published | CLEER factor release | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| CAIEC-1226 | December 2026 | 1226 | Latest |
| CAIEC-0926 | 29 September 2026 | 0926 | Superseded |
